tools.name: analysis.getTokenAiReport
tools.description:
Get Token AI Report
Query the AI-generated report for a single token.

Returns a structured report (report metadata, token metadata, and
content modules) for the given token. 

Minimal request: send only `token`. When `timestamp` is omitted the
latest available report is returned; when `product` is omitted it
defaults to `spot`. `expId` may be omitted.

Notes:
- Single-token query only; batch is not supported.
- Not strictly real-time — suitable for research, summarization, Q&A,
  and attribution rather than live market data.

token.description: Token symbol to query. The only required field.

timestamp.description:
Optional. Millisecond timestamp; returns the report closest to this
time. Recommended to omit — when absent the latest report is returned.

product.description:
Optional. Product domain of the report. Recommended to omit —
defaults to `spot`. Currently `spot` is the documented value.

expId.description: Optional. Experiment id; may be omitted, empty string, or null.
